title: Impact / Blast Radius (symbol)
summary: Reports what would be affected if a chosen symbol changes -- the set of code to retest
intro: Read this before changing a widely used method or type: it lists what would be affected if that symbol changes, so you know which code to retest. Give it the qualified name and, optionally, how many levels out to trace.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Impact / Blast Radius (symbol)...
steps: Needs an index of the project
drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Impact / Blast Radius (symbol)...
Enter the symbol; the affected code to retest is listed

help: an interface method also lists its implementors; an implementor, the interface sites reaching it
--format json: "implementors" [QName,...] and "via_dispatch" [{via,kind,sites}] (keys present only when non-empty; RB-5)

--all-projects: asks every database the manifest names instead of one (--db is refused). A project DB answers callers and implementors, a library declarations only; a section with no DB, an old schema or an unreadable file is a line of its own with its repair command, and so is a stale one

--format json with --all-projects: {qname,depth,platform,complete,found,declarations[],sections[{name,kind,db,state,repair,stale_files,target_declared,by_name_refs,levels[],implementors[{qname,edge}],via_dispatch[]}],summary}; exit 0 found, 1 found nowhere, 2 --db given or the manifest did not load. complete covers manifest sections only; a project the manifest does not name is not seen

questions.ask: What breaks if I change this symbol?
How far should the impact search reach?
What would changing this symbol touch in my other projects?
